_comment: STAGE-D per-batch coverage registry -- batch 'interop'
(docs/twin_validation/wave2_6_unit_test_contract.md SS12.3/12.4; full-coverage program).
Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULES: frontend/{pij,interop}.py -- package-local Spitz Eq.13 estimators plus the
record-facing {det,obs} -> matchable stim.DetectorErrorModel plumbing: exact pairwise
p_ij + odd-parity boundary-residual reduction (records_to_dem), a PyMatching MWPM adaptor
(decode_records), and a deterministic stim fault-injection utility (insert_op_after_tick).
CPU-only and imports NEITHER qec_twin NOR torch NOR quimb. PyMatching is optional [hw]:
real-decode tests skip in ecs and run in aiqec; package-port/guard coverage stays core.
FIVE LIVE public units:
spitz_pij_exact    -- exact Spitz Eq.13 estimator from detector population moments.
spitz_pij_delta_se -- exact per-shot moment-covariance delta-method SE.
records_to_dem       -- 6 ValueError guards; kept-edge loop body vs 0-edge loop; the
edge_factor<=NUMERICAL_ZERO clamp; the p_raw<=NUMERICAL_ZERO skip
vs the p_raw<-pair_floor_abs 'negative_residual' clamp; the
boundary logical True/False ternary; the p>_MAX_EDGE_P pair clamp
and the p_raw>_MAX_EDGE_P boundary clamp; the non-finite p_ij mask.
decode_records       -- ndim / binary-values / logical_index<0 / num_detectors / li>=n_obs guards +
predicted.ndim==1 reshape arc + the shape[1]!=n_obs guard.
insert_op_after_tick -- tick out of [0,total]; t==0 insert-before vs t>=1 insert-after;
the TICK-match and seen==t both arcs.
DISCRIMINATION (the prior-batch value-vs-shape lesson): every load-bearing assert PINS a
VALUE against an INDEPENDENT from-scratch Spitz recompute (_spitz_ref -- NOT the module's
spitz_pij_exact) or the EXACT odd-parity boundary identity, or asserts DISCRIMINATION
(assert_discriminates: floor bracket, _MAX_EDGE_P clamp, logical_index column selection,
insert-after-tick off-by-one). Deterministic exact-count population cubes (no sampling) make
every pin exact to 1e-12.
DEFENSIVE-ASSERT / SEAM. PyMatching's decode_batch always returns 2-D (N, n_obs) (measured:
stim 1.16 / pymatching 2.4), so the predicted.ndim==1 reshape arc and the shape[1]!=n_obs
guard are unreachable through the real backend; they are covered by tripping the package
decoder port (the sanctioned extract/trip-the-seam route), paired with the optional legit
2-D path property (test_L1_decode_output_contract).
The module's public constants (DEFAULT_PAIR_FLOOR_ABS, DEFAULT_PAIR_FLOOR_SIGMA) and the
private _MAX_EDGE_P are not defs => not public units; they are exercised via the unit pins.
